title: Hydroxyzine
overview:
Hydroxyzine is used to relieve itching caused by allergic skin reactions.
It is also used to relieve anxiety and tension.
Hydroxyzine is also used as a sedative before and after general anesthesia for surgery. Hydroxyzine is in a class of medications called antihistamines.
It works by blocking the action of histamine, a substance in the body that causes allergic symptoms. It also works by decreasing activity in the brain.
